introduction.section1: While Paris is inevitably the first city that comes to mind, France has so much more to discover. Dive into history-laden cities, visit museums, discover majestic castles. Stroll through charming hilltop villages in the South. Lounge on sunny beaches or go hiking to discover superb remote spots. France is also famous for its gastronomy - taste French specialties while savoring a good wine.
introduction.section2: Let us take you through our articles and photos on our journey through metropolitan France, region by region.
